name: pdf-to-md
description: Convert PDFs to Markdown with tables preserved, for feeding a local knowledge base. Requires pymupdf.

docs_dir.title: PDF folder
docs_dir.description: Folder of source PDFs. Read-only: conversion never alters a PDF. Only the top level is converted unless the server is launched with --recursive.

output_dir.title: Output folder
output_dir.description: Where the generated Markdown is written. Defaults inside the knowledge-base plugin's documents folder, so converting a PDF is the same act as adding it to the RAG corpus; point it outside C:\Eva\knowledge and the Markdown piles up unindexed.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Absolute path to the python.exe that has this server's pip dependencies installed (e.g. C:\Python311\python.exe). Use plain 'python' only if the right interpreter is first on PATH - a mismatch here is the most common cause of 'dependency missing' errors.
